patthana8.74:1.1: na saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana8.74:2.1: na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana8.74:3.1: na saraṇañca na araṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana8.74:4.1: hetuyā pañca. paccanīyadukapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. paccanīya dukattikapaṭṭhānaṃ na hetuduka nakusalattikaṃ
